description: This file defines components and functions related to table block options within a rich text editor plugin, including generating options based on user query patterns and handling table insertion commands.

methods.name: GetTableBlockOption
methods.description: Creates and returns a table block picker option component based on a given onSelect callback.

methods.name: GetDynamicTableBlocks
methods.description: Generates a list of table block options based on a query string input, supporting specific 'rows x columns' formats.
